reason: All software-only acceptance work is complete and v1.0.0-rc2 is published. Codex cannot deploy or collect real qualification evidence because this environment has no owner VPS access, Telegram credentials, restricted exchange credentials, dedicated-subaccount funding confirmation, or permission to make the public repository private. These external facts and secrets must be supplied out of band and must never be placed in Git, GitHub, artifacts, or chat.
required_inputs: An Ubuntu 24.04 VPS in Germany with root SSH/bootstrap access supplied out of band
Telegram bot token and numeric owner chat ID
Dedicated Binance USD-M, Bybit, and OKX subaccounts funded for shadow qualification
One restricted API key per dedicated Wave 1 subaccount with read and futures-trade permission, withdrawal/transfer/wallet/address-book/API-management disabled, and the VPS IP allowlisted
Owner authorization to change brullik/interexchange-perp-grid from PUBLIC to PRIVATE before operational evidence is uploaded
steps: Change brullik/interexchange-perp-grid visibility to Private and validate with: gh repo view brullik/interexchange-perp-grid --json visibility,isPrivate
On the Ubuntu 24.04 VPS, install the exact v1.0.0-rc2 checkout and run: sudo scripts/bootstrap-ubuntu.sh
Run: sudo ipegctl owner-onboard; enter the Telegram and restricted Wave 1 credentials only in this local terminal and type CONFIRM only for the factual account-safety prompts

Deploy the exact image with: sudo ipegctl deploy --image ghcr.io/brullik/interexchange-perp-grid@sha256:2c49fd425cdc9d247d9cc729e83ecb0f53e3c735d7e815ab279cee140bfe26da --release-sha 9d99e5bb774386de9314ad2cab125096675442a1
Validate with: sudo ipegctl doctor && sudo ipegctl status
Start shadow-only operation with: sudo ipegctl start-shadow; do not provide live-canary consent during onboarding
unblock_conditions: The repository query reports visibility=PRIVATE and isPrivate=true.
/etc/ipeg/ipeg.env is owned by root, has mode 0600, and is not tracked by Git.

ipegctl doctor reports PASS, mode=shadow, live_orders_allowed=false, release SHA 9d99e5bb774386de9314ad2cab125096675442a1, and image digest sha256:2c49fd425cdc9d247d9cc729e83ecb0f53e3c735d7e815ab279cee140bfe26da.
ipegctl status reports a qualification epoch for BTC:bybit>okx or an explicit fail-closed external blocker.
No withdrawal, transfer, or live-canary permission was granted.
forbidden_to_include: Exchange API keys, secrets, or passphrases
Wallet, withdrawal, transfer, address-book, or API-management permission
Live-canary consent or any real-order authorization
